title: Align Edit tool with the TS baseline
objective: Implement all Edit improvements identified by the per-tool subagent report so the Go clone matches the original TypeScript tool in public contract, runtime logic, robustness, state lifecycle, and tests.

context.problem: Exact surface; Go captures the main replace-text workflow well, but the original still has richer editor-aware instrumentation.
context.source_note: Synthesized because the initial early subagent report was returned in chat but not persisted by the read-only role; inputs were the current tools/reports markdown, the handoff summary, and the historical task JSON under ../tasks.

parallelization_notes: Can be assigned to an implementation subagent after listed dependencies are available. Avoid running concurrently with another task that owns the same files.

improvement_points.title: Define structured Edit output type
improvement_points.description: TS Edit returns {filePath, oldString, newString, occurrences, originalFile, structuredPatch}. Go currently returns a plain string.

improvement_points.title: Enforce Read-before-Edit via readFileState
improvement_points.description: TS rejects an Edit if no readFileState entry exists for the path or mtime drifted since last read.

improvement_points.title: Port applyEdit core algorithm
improvement_points.description: TS applyEdit.ts handles single-occurrence default, replace_all flag, and refuses ambiguous matches. Currently Go has a simpler implementation that misses replace_all and uniqueness check.

improvement_points.title: Port normaliseLineEndings for cross-platform parity
improvement_points.description: TS normalises CRLF to LF when matching but writes back original line endings of the file.

improvement_points.title: Generate structured patch in result
improvement_points.description: TS uses createPatch from 'diff' to produce unified-diff structuredPatch attached to result.

improvement_points.title: Port fileHistoryTrackEdit for undo and analytics
improvement_points.description: TS fileHistory.ts records every edit (path, before, after, hash, timestamp) so undo, history snapshots, and analytics work.

improvement_points.title: Run LSP diagnostics on changed file
improvement_points.description: TS posts the new file content to the LSP service and surfaces diagnostics in the tool result. Go has gosrc/tools/lsp.go but it is not wired into Edit.

improvement_points.title: Apply settings.json edit validator
improvement_points.description: TS treats edits to settings.json specially: parses the result and refuses if it would corrupt schema.

improvement_points.title: Allowed-dirs and symlink TOCTOU guard
improvement_points.description: TS rejects edits whose resolved path falls outside allowed_dirs or whose symlink target points outside.

improvement_points.title: Atomic write with cross-platform safety
improvement_points.description: Use existing atomic.go helper. Ensure mtime updates flow back to readFileState.

improvement_points.title: End-to-end Edit conformance tests
improvement_points.description: Lock behaviour against TS golden cases.

improvement_points.title: Normalize quotes and encodings exactly like TS Edit
improvement_points.description: Align quote normalization, file encoding detection, newline preservation, and byte output for non-UTF8 or mixed-encoding files.

improvement_points.title: Apply team-memory secret guard to Edit
improvement_points.description: Block or warn on edits to team memory/secret-bearing files using the same TS guardrails.

improvement_points.title: Wire Edit into skill discovery and conditional activation
improvement_points.description: After successful edits, trigger the same skill-discovery and conditional activation lifecycle TS uses for changed files.

improvement_points.title: Expose Edit gitDiff and remote diff analytics like TS
improvement_points.description: Return optional gitDiff using TS field names and feed remote diff/listener analytics from the changed file.

implementation_subtasks.title: Define structured Edit output type
implementation_steps: Define EditResult struct with the listed fields plus DurationMs and ReplaceAllUsed bool.
Add JSON marshalling that matches TS field names exactly.
Update Execute to return this struct in ToolResult.Data.
Provide a string render helper for transcript readability.
acceptance_criteria: Result JSON keys match TS
Existing string callers receive a sensible rendering
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS Edit returns {filePath, oldString, newString, occurrences, originalFile, structuredPatch}. Go currently returns a plain string.

implementation_subtasks.title: Enforce Read-before-Edit via readFileState
implementation_steps: Inject ReadFileState into FileEditTool constructor.
Before applying, lookup state[absPath]; if missing, return error 'File has not been read yet. Read it first before editing it.'
If mtime != stored TimestampMs, return error 'File has been modified since you last read it. Read it again before editing.'
Cover edge case: file did not exist when first 'read' (TS allows this) — permit edit if state.IsPartialView is false and mtime missing.
acceptance_criteria: Edit without prior Read fails
Edit after external modification fails
Read+Edit happy path passes
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS rejects an Edit if no readFileState entry exists for the path or mtime drifted since last read.

implementation_subtasks.title: Port applyEdit core algorithm
implementation_steps: Create gosrc/tools/file_edit_apply.go.
Implement ApplyEdit(content, oldString, newString string, replaceAll bool) (string, occurrences int, err error).
If replaceAll=false and occurrences != 1, return error matching TS message.
If oldString == newString, return error 'old_string and new_string must differ'.
If oldString is empty and the file is non-empty, reject.
Add 30+ table-driven tests.
acceptance_criteria: Single occurrence with replaceAll=false succeeds
Multiple occurrences with replaceAll=false fail
Replace_all rewrites every occurrence and reports count
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS applyEdit.ts handles single-occurrence default, replace_all flag, and refuses ambiguous matches. Currently Go has a simpler implementation that misses replace_all and uniqueness check.

implementation_subtasks.title: Port normaliseLineEndings for cross-platform parity
implementation_steps: Detect predominant line ending of source content.
Normalise oldString, newString, and content to LF for matching.
Restore original line endings on the resulting content before write.
Cover mixed-line-ending files by preserving file-wide style as TS does.
Add tests with CRLF, LF, and mixed inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Edits on CRLF file emit CRLF
Edits on LF file emit LF
oldString with CRLF still matches LF file content
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS normalises CRLF to LF when matching but writes back original line endings of the file.

implementation_subtasks.title: Generate structured patch in result
implementation_steps: Pick a Go diff library (github.com/sergi/go-diff or pmezard/go-difflib) or vendor minimal unified-diff implementation.
Generate patch with 3 lines of context, file header matching TS shape.
Attach to EditResult.StructuredPatch as []DiffHunk.
Add tests asserting hunk shape on representative diffs.
acceptance_criteria: Result includes hunks with oldStart/oldLines/newStart/newLines/lines
No spurious empty hunks
Patches are reproducible across platforms
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS uses createPatch from 'diff' to produce unified-diff structuredPatch attached to result.

implementation_subtasks.title: Port fileHistoryTrackEdit for undo and analytics
implementation_steps: Create gosrc/tools/file_edit_history.go with FileHistoryEntry { Path, Before, After string; Hash string; Tool string; Ts int64 }.
Implement TrackEdit(entry FileHistoryEntry) and ListEdits(path string) []FileHistoryEntry.
Persist to .claude/file-history/<sha1(path)>.jsonl with append-only writes.
Wire from Edit and Write tools.
Add concurrency tests.
acceptance_criteria: History entries persist across runs
Concurrent edits do not corrupt the file
ListEdits returns chronological order
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS fileHistory.ts records every edit (path, before, after, hash, timestamp) so undo, history snapshots, and analytics work.

implementation_subtasks.title: Run LSP diagnostics on changed file
implementation_steps: After successful write, call lsp.Diagnose(ctx, absPath, newContent).
Append diagnostics to EditResult.Diagnostics with severity, range, message.
Limit to the top 20 diagnostics to avoid spam.
Skip when no LSP available for the language.
acceptance_criteria: Edit on a file with syntax error includes diagnostic in result
Edit on a clean file returns empty diagnostics list
LSP failures do not block the edit
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS posts the new file content to the LSP service and surfaces diagnostics in the tool result. Go has gosrc/tools/lsp.go but it is not wired into Edit.

implementation_subtasks.title: Apply settings.json edit validator
implementation_steps: Detect when path basename is settings.json and parent is .claude or user config.
After computing newContent, parse as JSON; if invalid, error.
Validate against settings schema (reuse existing settings package).
Reject if disallowed keys removed.
Add tests.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid JSON edit rejected
Removing required key rejected
Valid setting tweak succeeds
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS treats edits to settings.json specially: parses the result and refuses if it would corrupt schema.

implementation_subtasks.title: Allowed-dirs and symlink TOCTOU guard
implementation_steps: Resolve path via filepath.EvalSymlinks; reject if outside allowed_dirs.
Detect symlinked file and refuse if target outside allowed_dirs.
Re-check after open via os.Stat to defeat TOCTOU.
Add tests with symlink fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Edit through symlink to outside allowed_dirs fails
Edit on regular file inside allowed_dirs succeeds
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS rejects edits whose resolved path falls outside allowed_dirs or whose symlink target points outside.

implementation_subtasks.title: Atomic write with cross-platform safety
implementation_steps: Replace direct ioutil.WriteFile with AtomicWriteFile.
After write, call ReadFileState.Set with new mtime.
Preserve file mode (chmod) and ownership where possible.
Add tests confirming partial-write does not leave corrupted file.
acceptance_criteria: File is replaced atomically (no zero-length window)
Read state mtime is updated
Mode preserved
implementation_subtasks.notes: Use existing atomic.go helper. Ensure mtime updates flow back to readFileState.

implementation_subtasks.title: End-to-end Edit conformance tests
implementation_steps: Mirror TS describe blocks into gosrc/tools/file_edit_conformance_test.go.
Cases: read-required, mtime drift, replace_all, structured patch shape, line-ending preservation, history persistence, diagnostics surfacing, symlink rejection.
acceptance_criteria: ≥40 conformance cases pass
Documented skips < 5
implementation_subtasks.notes: Lock behaviour against TS golden cases.

implementation_subtasks.title: Normalize quotes and encodings exactly like TS Edit
implementation_steps: Align quote normalization, file encoding detection, newline preservation, and byte output for non-UTF8 or mixed-encoding files.
acceptance_criteria: Smart-quote and escaped-quote matching mirrors TS.
Files with supported non-UTF8 encodings round-trip without corruption.

implementation_subtasks.title: Apply team-memory secret guard to Edit
implementation_steps: Block or warn on edits to team memory/secret-bearing files using the same TS guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Edits that would leak or overwrite team memory secrets are denied or routed through the TS-equivalent permission path.
implementation_subtasks.notes: Fresh-summary augmentation for early read-only subagent report.

implementation_steps: After successful edits, trigger the same skill-discovery and conditional activation lifecycle TS uses for changed files.
acceptance_criteria: Relevant conditional skills are activated after Edit when TS would activate them.
No activation occurs for unrelated files.

acceptance_criteria: Edit output can include TS-shaped gitDiff.
Analytics/listeners see the same changed-file payload as TS.

risks: Some subtasks touch shared runtime surfaces; coordinate with foundation tasks to avoid incompatible local adapters.
non_goals: Do not make unrelated behavior changes outside this tool unless required by a listed dependency.
notes_for_assignee: Start by adding or updating parity fixtures, then implement the smallest vertical slice that makes a failing fixture pass. Keep TS evidence lines in comments or test names where useful.
